items.title: Critical One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian’s Rovo AI Exposed Enterprise Data
items.description: The RovoBlast attack method identified by Varonis researchers could have been exploited to steal Confluence, Jira and SharePoint data. The post Critical One-Click Vulnerability in Atlassian’s Rovo AI Exposed Enterprise Data appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: New CSS Attacks Can Break Webmail Defenses to Steal Passwords and Tokens
items.description: New research shows content inside an email can escape its message boundary and interfere with the webmail interface.
